# The words of `#TS`

Every word is a `timeseries::line::` function of the timeseries library (`projects/timeseries/model.pure`):
what it computes is its Pure, what follows is read from its overloads as core compiles them. A word's
lines come first; a parameter not required has the library's default. A span is a window or a lag: a number
of observations (`20`), a calendar period (`3mo`), `all` (the line's start to date), or a date on
(`'2024-01-01'`), as the word's forms allow.

## `alpha`

The annualized alpha of x's simple returns over y's over a window -- w observations to date (a value once it holds two at least, and w), a calendar period back, the line's start to date; 63 observations unless given -- by the periods a year given (annualization_factor) or the dates infer.

| Parameter | Kind | Takes | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | line |  | yes |
| `y` | line |  | yes |
| `w` | span | observations, period, all | no |
| `annualization_factor` | whole |  | no |

Forms: `alpha(x: Line, y: Line, annualization_factor: Integer (optional))`, `alpha(x: Line, y: Line, w: Integer, annualization_factor: Integer (optional))`, `alpha(x: Line, y: Line, w: Scope, annualization_factor: Integer (optional))`, `alpha(x: Line, y: Line, w: Integer, unit: DurationUnit, annualization_factor: Integer (optional))`.
